RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel indicates poor diversity governance and can foster affinity bias, but it does not alone establish discrimination. For a "head of" role, broad regulatory experience and executive management often outweigh technical depth, providing a legitimate business justification for their choice.

Whether to raise it depends on your objective. Directly alleging bias now will likely burn professional bridges and trigger legal defensiveness without yielding answers. Instead, follow up professionally to secure your written feedback. If the response is evasive or inconsistent, or if institutional policy explicitly mandates diverse interview panels, you can reassess whether to escalate through HR or consult an employment specialist.
